Designing Parametric Sources

Parametric source design – documentation.

This archive examines how shared typographic principles are divided into project-specific design parameters, and how those parameters behave across glyphs, scripts, and styles.

About

A parametric source is not simply a variation-axis value. It is a design decision expressed through measurements, glyph constructions, and related groups of forms. This documentation makes those relationships visible.

Explore the documentation

  • Tutorials — learn the system through guided examples.
  • How-to guides — complete a specific task.
  • Explanation — understand the ideas behind parametric sources.
  • Reference — inspect axes, projects, and proofing specimens.

Current scope

The first documented project is Amstelvar. Its specimens provide a working proof of concept for a larger, cross-project reference including Roboto Delta and Computer Modern.
